text: The proposed update changes the cache lifetime from five minutes to fifteen minutes. A twenty-four-hour benchmark observed eighteen percent fewer origin requests. The reduction is operationally promising. Read broadly, those findings might seem to favor immediate expansion, but the supported conclusion is narrower: the evidence warrants a limited experiment, not a broad rollout. Here is the boundary: the benchmark did not measure stale-read incidence. That omission limits only the scale of the next action; it does not undo the positive evaluation of the measured result. Approve only a canary deployment, and require stale-read telemetry before any broader rollout. This bounded approval follows directly from the observed evidence and its stated limitation.
